title: Medical Document Translation Workflow: Costs and Quality
summary: Build a medical document translation workflow for source control, quality checks, cost planning, secure handling, release, and version updates.
body_markdown:
###


A complete workflow identifies the source owner, source version, target language and locale, approved terminology, privacy path, quality checks, release authority, delivery format, and future review date.


###


Include source preparation, translation, quality checks, formatting, secure handling, corrections, and future updates. A per-word quote does not capture the full lifecycle cost.


###


It may be appropriate for public, non-sensitive text if the output is checked for its intended use. Do not submit patient information until the organization has verified the product, contract, configuration, data handling, and any required Business Associate Agreement.


###


No universal rule requires human review of every document. Set the review method according to the document purpose, risk, organizational policy, receiving-party requirements, and the safeguards available.


###


Verify meaning, terminology, numbers, units, dates, negation, formatting, links, contact details, source version, target locale, approval owner, and review date.
